title: Royalnetwork SMP
description: Royal Network is a new survival server running on version 1.21.11 that does not require a premium subscription. The server features a grave system that keeps players' items safe and player-run markets that boost the economy.
body:
# 👑 Royal Network SMP Server Is Now Open! 👑

Hello, Valued Players!

The brand-new survival experience you’ve been waiting for—Royal Network SMP—is now live in our community! 💥
You’re all invited to this adventure where you’ll have a blast with friends, build your own economy, and push the limits.



## 🧠 About

- 🧩 Highlights:
- 🎙️ In-Game Voice Chat: Chat with your friends right in the game using proximity-based voice chat!
- 🪵 Timber System: Easily fell trees in one go by breaking them from the bottom up.

- 🪦 Grave System: When you die, your items won’t scatter and disappear—they’ll be waiting for you in your own grave!
- 🏪 Player Markets: Display your items and trade using shelf-based shop systems.

- 🖼️ Custom Media: Frame your own pictures and liven up the atmosphere with custom music discs!
- 🌎 RTP (Random Teleportation): Teleport to the depths of the wild with a single click and start your adventure.

- 🛡️ Safe Gaming: Your hard work is protected with advanced anti-cheat measures and a block/grief tracking system.



## 💻 Server Information
- 🧱 IP: oyna.royalnetwork.xyz

- 🌍 Game Version: 1.21.11

- 💎 Is Premium Required? No, premium is not required! (Your skins will display seamlessly in-game)
- 🔐 Registration System: The game has an in-game Login/Register system.

- ⚠️ Important Note: Don’t forget to install the Simple Voice Chat mod on your computer or in your mod pack to use voice chat!
**
